claim: The rendered Prometheus rules, Prometheus scrape config, and Alertmanager config, including the equities-broker-path alert group (now six alerts after the fix round added EquitiesLedgerUnreadable) and adaptive-paper scrape job, pass the pinned promtool/amtool checks. No broker connection, credentials, or live paper trial were used; only a fixture ledger built from safety.Ledger's own serialisation.
fix_round_note: Second pass resolved three review findings: (1) EcosystemServiceUnavailable now excludes job=adaptive-paper so the pre-existing rule does not fire permanently when no paper trial is running; (2) metrics.py now always exports paper_ledger_readable and a new EquitiesLedgerUnreadable alert guards a wrong --ledger path / permissions problem / failed sqlite open, which previously left the four conditionally-emitted ledger metrics silently absent with nothing to alert on -- EquitiesPaperMetricsMissing's annotation no longer claims to cover that case; (3) EquitiesReconciliationFailed now also fires on paper_reconciliation_status{result="needs_attention"} == 1 to catch a trial that failed and was then recovered flat (runner.py sets phase="finished" from the post-recovery flat flag independently of status). All three fixes have regression tests in tests/test_adaptive_paper_metrics.py and tests/test_observability_backends_alerts.py. The hard-killed-runner (stuck phase=starting) gap remains unguarded pending paper_reconciliation_last_success_timestamp_seconds becoming exportable; this was already a documented, not a newly introduced, gap.
rendered_into: temporary directory only; not a persistent installation prefix, not started as a service

alertmanager_route_added.note: The default (unmatched) route already sends everything to local-ntfy; this sub-route makes the equities-broker scope explicit and independently testable rather than changing delivery.

metrics_exporter_tests.fixture_source: safety.Ledger + safety.RiskLimits (real durable ledger writes), no hand-built SQLite rows
scenarios: missing ledger/trial.json (always-on gauges still exported, paper_ledger_readable=0)
healthy active trial (paper_trial_active=1, paper_ledger_readable=1, full request budget)
frozen ledger via a risk-cap reason (paper_ledger_frozen set, divergence stays 0)
idempotent second freeze() call (divergence counter stays 1)
unreadable ledger file (0000 permissions, fix round): paper_ledger_readable=0, paper_trial_active still 1, divergence/frozen/budget series absent -- the scenario EquitiesLedgerUnreadable guards

recovered-flat trial (fix round): phase="finished"/status="needs_attention" reports paper_needs_attention=0 but paper_reconciliation_status{result="needs_attention"}=1 -- the scenario EquitiesReconciliationFailed's added clause guards
real loopback HTTP server serving /metrics on an ephemeral port
credentials-canary isolation: 0000-permission env file is never opened by render_metrics()

limitations: Synthetic fixture ledger only; no live NautilusTrader/Alpaca paper session, broker connection, or credentials were exercised in producing this receipt.

paper_reconciliation_last_success_timestamp_seconds and paper_request_budget_wait_exceeded_total are not exported by metrics.py because they are not durably recorded by the current safety.py/runner.py ledger schema; the corresponding clauses in EquitiesReconciliationFailed and EquitiesRequestBudgetExhausted are syntactically valid but currently dormant (see metrics.py module docstring for the exact gap). This also means a hard-killed runner whose trial.json stays stuck at phase="starting" has no guarding alert (only the dormant clause would have caught it); this is an existing, documented gap, not introduced or closed by the fix round.

paper_order_state_divergence_total only counts risk_halt events with reason=external_order_detected; runner.reconcile()'s position/cash/intent mismatches raise SafetyError without writing a ledger event and are not counted.

promtool/amtool were run against a temporary rendered config directory, not the operator's live $STACK_CONFIG_ROOT; no running Prometheus/Alertmanager instance evaluated these rules against real time-series data.
The alertmanager scope=equities-broker sub-route was checked with amtool check-config only; amtool's interactive route-matching simulation was not separately exercised in this receipt.

paper_ledger_readable reflects only the single scrape's open attempt; a transient failure that self-heals before the next scrape will show a brief dip rather than a sustained absence, which is why EquitiesLedgerUnreadable uses for: 2m rather than firing instantly.
